ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity pixels (distributed across lateral lobes) to low-intensity pixels (concentrated in the medial and peduncle regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region centered at the notch, extending to the trailing edge. Right lobe contains discrete low-intensity circular clusters. Left lobe lateral region exhibits high-intensity background with parallel vertical dark bands at the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending ~15% into the fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitudes; right lobe trailing edge shows deeper jagged valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of 4-6 dark circular pixel groupings located on the mid-lateral area of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe; several vertical linear markings on the outer edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular serrations on the right lateral tip and distinct rake mark patterns across the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: One vertical high-intensity (white) linear streak located on the dark pigmentation immediately to the right of the median notch.
